rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for evidence or proof of a fact.

example.english: This document is testimony to the fact that the incident really happened.
example.traditional: 呢份文件就係證據，證明件事真係發生過。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 zau6 hai6 zing3 geoi3 zing3 ming4 gin6 si6 zan1 hai6 faat3 saang1 gwo3

rows.note: Use this when something serves as a sign or testimony to an achievement or fact.

example.english: Winning this award is testimony to years of hard work.
example.traditional: 佢攞到呢個獎，係多年努力嘅見證。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lo2 dou3 ni1 go3 zoeng2 hai6 do1 nin4 nou5 lik6 ge3 gin3 zing3

rows.note: Use this for what a witness says as evidence in court.

example.english: The witness's testimony in court was crucial.
example.traditional: 證人喺庭上嘅證供好關鍵。
example.jyutping: zing3 jan4 hai2 ting4 soeng6 ge3 zing3 gung1 hou2 gwaan1 gin6
